content.short: Philippines digital bank with consumer accounts and cards.
content.description: Tonik is a digital bank in the Philippines, widely recognized as one of the country's first neobanks to hold a digital banking licence from the central bank. Operating entirely through its app, Tonik offers high-yield savings accounts and 'Stashes', deposit accounts, debit cards, and consumer loans, targeting Filipinos who are underbanked or seeking better returns than traditional banks provide. It focuses on attractive interest rates, fast digital onboarding, and secure deposits to win trust in a market where many people are new to formal banking. By combining savings, deposits, cards, and credit in a mobile-first experience, Tonik competes with other Philippine digital banks and incumbents for the country's fast-growing base of smartphone-using consumers.
